		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_selected_SHIP_rune_1
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_selected_SHIP_rune_2
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = DA_selected_SHIP_rune_1
		}
		clr_country_flag = DA_UNIT_DESIGN_IN_USE
	}
}
